subject: Variable-length data items
notes: §8.5.1.10.4 + §15.50.4 GR6: a dynamic-length item overwritten by a shorter value or an empty value keeps no residue (3[ABCDEFGHIJ] 3LEN=10, 4[] 4LEN=00); §14.6.9.2: a dynamic table overwritten by a group MOVE gives G=01 888 and never resurrects the freed 666 (H=03 888000999).
